content: भवत् {%a.%} (-न्ती|{%f.%}) .²1 Being, becoming, happening. .²2 Present; समतीतं च भवच्च भावि च <ls>R. 8. 78</ls>. --{%<ab>pron. a.</ab>%} .({@-ती@} {%f.%}) A respectful or honorific pronoun, translated by ‘your honour’, ‘your lordship, worship or highness’; (<ab>oft.</ab> used in the sense of the second personal pronoun, but with the third person of the verb); अथवा कथं भवान् मन्यते <ls>M. 1</ls>; भवन्त एव जानन्ति रघूणां च कुलस्थितिम् <ls>U. 5. 23</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 40</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 16</ls>. It is often joined to अत्र or तत्र (see the words), and sometimes to स also; यन्मां विधेयविषये सभवान्नियुङ्क्ते <ls>Māl. 1. 9</ls>.
